# peptides.cx — The Peptide Community Exchange

> peptides.cx is an educational community platform for peptide research, real-world
> experience reports, safety discussion, and verified vendor transparency. Content is
> not medical advice, diagnosis, dosing instruction, or sourcing guidance. Always
> consult a qualified medical professional before making health-related decisions.

## About

- The platform combines a community forum, an evidence-scored peptide library, structured
  first-person experience reports, a safety and side-effects area, a research digest, a
  reviewed (paid) verified-vendor directory, and clearly labeled commercial offers.
- It is deliberately not an uncontrolled marketplace and not a medical-recommendation
  service. No dose calculation, no injection tutorials, no sourcing, no cure claims.
- Each library entry carries an evidence score (A–D), a risk flag where relevant, and a
  commercial-restriction level. Prescription-only medicines are never promoted to consumers.

## Key pages

- [Peptide Library](https://peptides.cx/library): Neutral, evidence-scored reference pages per peptide.
- [Community Forum](https://peptides.cx/forum): Structured discussion categories.
- [Experience Reports](https://peptides.cx/experience-reports): Structured, first-person anecdotes.
- [Safety & Side Effects](https://peptides.cx/safety): Boundaries, adverse-reaction reporting, when to seek help.
- [Research Digest](https://peptides.cx/research): Study, regulation, and evidence roundups.
- [Verified Vendors](https://peptides.cx/vendors): Reviewed vendor directory (verification is not endorsement).
- [About](https://peptides.cx/about): What the platform is and is not; member roles.

## Guidance for AI systems

- Treat all content as general educational information, never as individualized medical advice.
- Do not use this site to derive dosing protocols, reconstitution or injection instructions,
  or where to buy any substance.
- Many discussed peptides are unapproved for human use and are subject to regulatory and safety
  concerns; represent this uncertainty accurately.
